family_name: Trade Select NC Thermal Break Strips

spec.description:
Trade Select Non-combustible
ThermalBreak Strip (by Ametalin) is a high-performance thermal break solution
engineered for commercial and residential steel-framed wall and roof
constructions. Tested to AS 1530.1 and classified as Not Deemed Combustible, it
complies with NCC Volume One C1.9 / C2D10 and Volume Two Part 3.7.1 / H3D2 for
all non-combustible building constructions. Built with a dense, chemically
stable, compression-resistant core, it isolates steel framing from exterior
claddings and roofing to eliminate thermal bridging without compromising fire
compliance.
features:
Classified as Not Deemed Combustible when tested in
accordance with AS 1530.1

Delivers in-situ R0.24 thermal break, exceeding the
NCC R0.20 requirement for steel framing

Engineered for commercial and
multi-residential Type A, B, and C non-combustible steel-frame buildings

Highly compression-resistant, providing a solid, stable base for cladding
screws
Easily cuts to length on site using a utility knife or shears

Non-irritant and odorless with low VOC
emissions

Suitable for all Bushfire Attack Levels (BAL Low to BAL-FZ) under
AS 3959

technical.value:
High compressive strength
under cladding fastener loads

range.variant: Trade Select NC ThermalBreak Strip 45mm x 1200mm

spec.fire:
Tested to AS 1530.1 and classified as Not Deemed Combustible; Suitable for
BAL-12.5 to BAL-FZ in accordance with AS 3959
spec.compliance:
NCC 2019 /
NCC 2022 Volume One (C1.9, C2D10, J4D3) and Volume Two (Part 3.7.1,
H3D2, 13.2.2); AS 1530.1; AS/NZS 4859.1
spec.sustainability:
Zero ODP; low VOC
emissions; non-hazardous; fiber-free
install:
Ensure steel frame studs,
noggings, or roof purlins are clean, dry, and free of oil

Apply wall wrap or
roof sarking over the steel framing in accordance with AS/NZS 4200.2

Position
Non-combustible ThermalBreak Strip continuously along the steel stud or purlin
face over the wrap

Fasten cladding or battens directly through the thermal
break strip into the steel framing

Ensure cladding screws compress the strip
firmly without over-tightening to crush the core

Butt strip ends tightly
together along the length of the steel member
selection_checklist:
Confirm project requires AS 1530.1 non-combustible thermal break for commercial
or multi-residential steel framing

Measure total linear meterage of steel
framing faces needing thermal break

Confirm width (45mm) matches stud flange
width

Select plain version (without adhesive backing) for clamp/friction
applications
limitations:
Non-structural
spacer; cladding fasteners must penetrate into steel frame members

Must be
installed on the exterior face of steel framing before cladding

Must not be
left exposed to permanent UV weather without cladding
spec.warranty:
15 Year
Product Warranty backed by Ametalin

retrieval.rag_summary:
Trade Select NC
Thermal Break Strips (by Ametalin) are 10mm x 45mm x 1200mm rigid strips
engineered to provide a certified non-combustible thermal break on steel-framed
walls and roofs. Tested to AS 1530.1 and classified as Not Deemed Combustible,
they deliver an in-situ rating of R0.24 to comfortably exceed the NCC R0.20
thermal break mandate without introducing combustible foams into commercial
facades. Termite-proof, compression-resistant, and suitable for all bushfire
levels up to BAL-FZ, they eliminate steel frame thermal bridging.
